1445-2511-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2511-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2416-3469-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
2416-3469-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
2416-3469-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Rise and Shine.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

5220-6826-6900-7492.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
5220-6826-6900-7492.description:
Cast Masked Meower by paying its mana cost.
Activate Masked Meower by sacrificing it.
When Masked Meower dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Masked Meower from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Masked Meower from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1115-1368-6321-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1115-1368-6321-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2866-4970-5751-7693--49.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
2866-4970-5751-7693--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1451-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Pyreheart Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
1451-5231-6972.notes: If Pyreheart Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

618-4456-4668-7494.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
618-4456-4668-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R} due to Heliod
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-4456-4668-7494.notes: If opponents have drawn more cards, the starting cost is reduced by {1} and you'll net infinite red mana.

3121-4050-4853-7452.description:
Activate Cauldron of Essence by paying {1}{B}{G}, tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, and Dross Scorpion triggers if the creature was an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, if applicable, untapping an artifact.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence ability from step 1, returning Marionette Master from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Marionette Master enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Marionette Master and two tokens, adding {1}{B}{G}.
When Marionette Master and the tokens die, Dross Scorpion triggers three times, untapping Cauldron of Essence and two other artifacts.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2011-2215.easyPrerequisites: You have three or more opponents.
2011-2215.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
2011-2215.description:
Deal combat damage to at least three opponents, triggering Grim Hireling, creating two Treasure tokens for each opponent dealt combat damage.
Holding priority, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to untap all attacking creatures you control, give them lifelink, trample and haste, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
2011-2215.notes: The combo fails to produce enough mana once you have two or fewer opponents

3678-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

14-147-997.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

339-677-2292-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

3951-4452-5703-5921.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: can be transformed and with indestructible

1939-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1939-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-2583-5666-5870.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

851-4094-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
851-4094-5658-6245.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
851-4094-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3490-4616-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2180-3693-4613.notablePrerequisites: Nearheath Stalker has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2180-3693-4613.description:
Activate Nearheath Stalker using Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 until Nearheath Stalker has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Nearheath Stalker abilities dealing 1 damage to Nearheath Stalker, and any remaining damage to any target(s).
Nearheath Stalker dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Nearheath Stalker's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1137-1931-2882-4999.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Rith's Attendant.
1137-1931-2882-4999.description:
Cast Wild Dogs either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {G}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Rith's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Wild Dogs by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{G}{W}.
If you cast Wild Dogs from your graveyard, Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.

500-851-2047-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-851-2047-4365.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

969-1170-2055-2175-3390.description:
Activate The Face of Boe by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast Lotus Bloom from your hand.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The Face of Boe.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Auriok Salvagers by paying {1}{W}, returning Lotus Bloom to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1124-2034-2696-5082.description:
Activate Garruk's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating two 2/2 Wolf creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Wolves, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Wolves die, they trigger, putting two loyalty counters on each Garruk planeswalker you control.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil and up to other other creature and/or land you control, and causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

232-2136-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
232-2136-2178-4050.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask with haste.
When the token Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Priest of Urabrask token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Priest of Urabrask token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead use Orthion's second ability to make copies of any creature(s) you control.

1703-2034-2880-3783.notablePrerequisites: You control another Illusion with power five or greater.
1703-2034-2880-3783.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another Illusion with power five or greater, adding {C}{C}.
The Illusion dies, triggering Minn's second ability, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Phantasmal Dreadmaw.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Dreadmaw, adding {C}{C}.
Phantasmal Dreadmaw dies, triggering Minn's second ability and Fool's Demise's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Phantasmal Dreadmaw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Minn trigger, putting Fool's Demise from your hand onto the battlefield attached to Phantasmal Dreadmaw.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2738-3263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead, adding {C}{C}.
Tenacious Dead dies, causing you to pay {2} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

776-1329-4808.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4808.description:
Cast Black Lotus.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1.
You may Draw a card and discard a card.
Activate Black Lotus, sacrificing it to add three mana of any color.
Activate Emry targeting Black Lotus in your graveyard.
Repeat.

937-2749-4695.description:
During your upkeep, activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life, giving Wall of Blood +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

957-2334-2493.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
